mission.beneficiary: Prospective users and contributors who need evidence that Gahyeon behaves as a responsive realtime character rather than only as a collection of source-connected subsystems.
mission.consequential_choice: sequence: position the packaged Unreal realtime vertical slice as the next milestone, run its dependency-and-contract probe first, continue only if prerequisites survive, and explicitly defer production migration clearance and character-identity candidate promotion
falsifiers: A usable UE 5.6 and MetaHuman environment, target machine, audio device, or required provider access is unavailable and has no bounded acquisition path.
The project cannot produce or repeatedly run a packaged build on the declared target.
Applied listening-pose, speech, or viseme latency misses the predeclared acceptance thresholds.
Late cognition, STT, TTS, or engine callbacks revive cancelled work or corrupt the active generation.
Barge-in fails to stop playback and restore a valid conversational state.
The proposed minimal loop requires substantial Looking Glass, World, NavMesh, character-identity, or production-deployment work to function.
mission.interpretation: Select the packaged Unreal realtime vertical slice as the next cross-project milestone, conditionally sequenced behind a low-cost availability and scope probe. It has greater beneficiary value and integration information gain than another source-level migration check or premature character iteration, while a predeclared stop condition limits exposure if UE, MetaHuman, device, or provider prerequisites are unavailable.
mission.mission: Define and prove one minimal packaged Unreal 5.6 conversation loop: voice activity triggers an applied listening pose, Korean speech is recognized, cognition produces interruptible speech with applied visemes, and barge-in returns the character to a valid state without stale callbacks reviving cancelled work. First verify all required tooling and resources; if any essential prerequisite lacks a concrete acquisition path, stop this milestone rather than beginning integration.
mission.next_probe: Write a revision-pinned one-page slice contract mapping the exact scenario, repetitions, artifacts, and thresholds to the smallest necessary subset of RT-02, RT-04, RT-05, RT-08, and RT-11; then inventory confirmed access to UE 5.6, compatible MetaHuman assets, a target machine, microphone/audio output, Korean STT, cognition, and TTS. Proceed only if every essential dependency is present or has a bounded owner and acquisition path.
non_goals: Clearing production deployment or claiming migration safety without live Flyway history and representative-scale measurements.
Promoting v10 or v11 to an identity candidate without authorized canonical references, populated review evidence, and named human approval.
Validating Looking Glass hardware, broad World or NavMesh behavior, every RT-01–RT-13 row, arm64 publishing, or multi-machine portability.
Polishing a showcase through demo-specific architectural shortcuts.
mission.rationale: This gate composes the largest body of existing verified work into credible user-facing evidence and tests whether the architecture survives real engine, audio, provider, timing, and cancellation boundaries. It is reversible because the initial slice contract and dependency inventory require little implementation, the scope excludes unrelated engine features, and failure yields specific integration evidence. Migration preflight is deferred because it cannot establish production readiness without authorized live history and scale measurements. Character v11 is deferred because candidate status cannot be credible without authorized references, declared thresholds, and named reviewers.
mission.situation: Gahyeon has broad repository-verified Core, transport, Desktop, audio, cancellation, replay, and RuntimeCore evidence, but lacks an end-to-end user-facing proof. Production migration clearance depends on unavailable live database history, and character-candidate promotion depends on unpublished identity references and human approval. Packaged Unreal acceptance also has external dependencies, but it offers the strongest conversion of existing technical breadth into a visible experience if those dependencies are first confirmed.
mission.success_signal: On one declared target machine, a packaged Unreal 5.6 build completes the bounded conversation loop repeatedly with recorded audiovisual evidence, UE Automation results, latency traces against predeclared RT-02, RT-04, RT-05, RT-08, and RT-11 thresholds, successful barge-in recovery, and zero stale-callback resurrection across cancellation and reordered provider responses.

acceptance_tests: The approved contract identifies the repository revision, contract version, one target configuration, packaged-build configuration, Korean scenario, repetition count, numeric thresholds, correlation rules, diagnostic allowance, required artifacts, exclusions, and stop rules.
Every essential prerequisite is verified available or has an approved bounded acquisition owner, path, decision date, cost cap, and time ceiling; otherwise the milestone stops before integration.
The same identified packaged Unreal 5.6 build can be produced, launched, and instrumented repeatedly on the declared target.
For every contracted repetition, VAD leads to a listening pose confirmed as actually applied by the Unreal presentation boundary and satisfies the frozen RT-02 threshold.
Korean microphone input is recognized across the frozen RT-11 sample count and satisfies the contracted latency and recognition-quality thresholds.
Cognition produces audible, interruptible speech whose audio, generation, epoch, and state transitions remain correlated.

Visemes derived from qualifying exact timing evidence are confirmed as actually applied by the Unreal presentation boundary and satisfy the frozen RT-08 synchronization threshold; heuristic-only or cursor-only evidence does not pass.

Barge-in stops device playback within the frozen RT-05 threshold, cancels active work, resets mouth and presentation state, and returns the character to the contractually defined valid recovered state.
Deliberately late or reordered cognition, STT, TTS, transport, and engine callbacks never replace the active generation, revive cancelled audio or work, or corrupt presentation state.
The contracted RT-04 adversarial cases report zero stale-callback resurrection.
Each assertion has audiovisual evidence, UE Automation results where applicable, correlated traces, artifact and target identities, integrity checks, and an explicit pass or fail.
The final reviewer confirms evidence completeness without asserting production migration readiness, identity approval, broader Unreal acceptance, portability, or general release readiness.

A.first_authorized_action: No execution action is authorized by this handoff. The first action to seek authorization for is drafting the revision-pinned one-page slice contract and performing read-only prerequisite and resource inventory checks for G0 and G1; packaging, integration, credential use, reservations, and spending remain unauthorized until the project's normal approval process permits them.
A.plan_summary: Make the packaged Unreal Engine 5.6 realtime vertical slice the next cross-project milestone, conditionally gated by a revision-pinned slice contract and prerequisite inventory. Freeze the smallest necessary RT-02, RT-04, RT-05, RT-08, and RT-11 assertions and thresholds; proceed through packaged-boundary, bounded-loop, and adversarial-acceptance gates only when each prior gate passes. Explicitly defer production migration clearance and character-identity candidate promotion.
risk_controls: Stop at G1 if any essential engine, asset, machine, audio, provider, credential, capture, reviewer, timebox, or budget prerequisite lacks an approved bounded acquisition path.
Use separate phase ceilings plus an overall stop date or effort ceiling; reaching any ceiling before contracted acceptance causes stop or explicit rescope.
Require a capped spending approval before incurring provider, hardware, engine, plugin, asset, or capture costs.
Pin the repository revision, contract version, packaged artifact identity, engine and plugin versions, target metadata, and non-secret provider configuration identifiers in all evidence.
Measure pose, viseme, playback, recovery, and state at the packaged Unreal presentation boundary; do not substitute source-level, reference, Desktop, heuristic-only, or cursor-only evidence.
Fence all provider, transport, and engine callbacks by active generation and runtime epoch and test deliberate cancellation and response reordering.
Permit only the contract's bounded diagnostic allowance after a failed packaging or loop assertion; require a new rescope decision for broader work.
Stop if the minimal loop requires substantial Looking Glass, World, NavMesh, character-identity, production-deployment, or showcase-specific work.
Keep migration clearance and identity-candidate promotion explicitly deferred and prevent the slice disposition from implying either approval.
Use a non-candidate presentation asset only after confirming the required pose and viseme channels and recording that technical acceptance conveys no identity approval.
Retain failed or superseded evidence with provenance, mark it non-authoritative, and require a new contract version for reruns after material changes.

sequence.entry_gate: G0-MISSION-ALIGNMENT: the draft contract preserves the selected mission and explicitly excludes migration clearance, identity promotion, Looking Glass, broad World or NavMesh work, general-release claims, and architectural shortcuts.
sequence.exit_gate: G1-PREREQUISITE-GO: acceptance values are frozen and every essential dependency and resource is verified available or covered by an approved bounded acquisition path; otherwise stop.

sequence.entry_gate: G1-PREREQUISITE-GO has passed through the project's normal approval process.
sequence.exit_gate: G2-PACKAGED-BOUNDARY: the identified build is repeatedly produced, launched, captured, and instrumented on the declared target, including presentation-boundary pose and viseme confirmation capability.

G3-LOOP-READINESS: one end-to-end loop demonstrates applied listening pose, Korean recognition, interruptible TTS, applied visemes, valid barge-in recovery, and active-generation correlation without excluded work.

G4-MILESTONE-DISPOSITION: the complete evidence bundle gives every contracted assertion a traceable pass or fail and supports only a passed, stopped, or explicitly rescoped packaged-slice disposition.

acceptance_tests: A packaged Unreal Engine 5.6 build is produced and repeatedly launched on one declared target machine.

Barge-in stops audible playback on the real output device, cancels the active generation, resets mouth and presentation state, and returns the character to the contractually defined valid conversational state within the RT-05 threshold.
Late cognition, STT, TTS, HTTP, PCM, engine, and reordered provider callbacks from cancelled generations are rejected and never replace or revive the active presentation.
Cancellation and deliberately reordered provider-response trials record zero stale-callback resurrection events across all contracted repetitions.

UE Automation results, audiovisual recordings, latency traces, percentile calculations, generation and runtime-epoch logs, provider ordering logs, build identity, machine identity, and device identity are captured for the same tested revision.

The minimal loop completes without requiring Looking Glass hardware, broad World or NavMesh behavior, identity-candidate promotion, production deployment work, arm64 publishing, or multi-machine portability.
